id: Merancang dan mengembangkan aplikasi web evaluasi kinerja dengan menggunakan Laravel, PHP, MySQL, dan Bootstrap.

Menerapkan sistem autentikasi yang aman serta kontrol akses berbasis peran (Role-Based Access Control) guna menjamin kerahasiaan data evaluasi karyawan.
Meningkatkan efisiensi waktu seleksi karyawan secara signifikan, dari 4–5 minggu secara manual menjadi hanya 1,79 menit untuk 10 kriteria penilaian.
en: Developed a full-stack web application for library management by leveraging the MVC architecture (Laravel, PHP, MySQL, Bootstrap) to digitize institutional operations.
Reduced book data entry time from 5 minutes to 2 minutes per record by optimizing the form interface.
Implemented bulk data import functionality via Excel, along with automated report export capabilities in both PDF and Excel formats.
Integrated instant search features based on specific criteria to accelerate archival book data retrieval for staff.
